title: Virtual IP, DNS and the application that has to notice the switch

videos.script: A failover picks a new primary. The application still has the old address in its configuration. {{address}} There are four places to keep the answer: the connection string, a proxy, an address that moves, or a name in DNS. {{four}} You list all three servers in one connection string, and let the client find the one that takes writes. {{client}} Then you put HAProxy in front, asking Patroni every two seconds which node is the primary. {{proxy}} And you switch the leader while an application places an order every second. Two orders fail, and a long connection is cut in the middle of its query. {{switch}} No address can carry an open connection to another server. The application has to reconnect, and retry. {{retry}}
